checks.detail: Source inspection supports the discovery, current-cart hook/direct no-cart confirmation, explicit resume/retire, verified webhook, official finalizer and effect-hook mapping. The installed native-completion gap is accurately identified and not presented as repaired. Candidate/source hashes remain consistent with the frozen manifest.

Reconciliation-design sections 3–4 separate read-only R, bounded server-owned C and explicit P. Exact identity, snapshot/store/channel checks, privacy, browser authority, persistent accounting, locks, holds and sole-finalizer ownership survive the proposed paths without new access grants.

The outcome matrix distinguishes known failure, receipt defects, authentication, selection and rate/budget stops from financial uncertainty. It avoids compulsory identical customer retries, invented support powers, notifications, persistence promises and copy approval.

The source map and I0–I6 cover active shop/recovery callers, both confirmation branches, restoration/redirect, signed events and explicit payment operations. Non-claim transaction callers, stock, allowance, admissions, benefits, physical fulfillment and return regressions remain explicit.

B01–B16 and the crosswalk cover consumed-body transport versus malformed receipts, native completion versus API fulfillment, stale identities, server-still-in-flight timeouts, distinct provider observations, held/terminal states, selection and catch-up failures. None authorizes automatic charging, reopening, retirement, age-based release or hold reset.

Each implementation slice has three verifiable criteria, dependencies, affected callers and additional acceptance gates. I0 precedes financial guarantees; full identity readiness and bounded policy precede UI activation; durable catch-up remains required for task completion. No RED/GREEN, runtime or device evidence is fabricated.

Timing, budgets, retention, catch-up mechanism and operational authority remain explicit gates. The financial brief and governing commerce plan are preserved; external actions, dependencies, services, credentials, publication, readiness and deployment remain separately excluded or approved.

Current behavior and proposals are clearly separated. Coordination cannot rely on lease expiry to prove completion, nested transaction deadlock risk is exposed, and durable catch-up is required rather than claimed operational. Custodian-only acceptance and registry ownership remain intact. This is design-quality approval only, not owner or runtime acceptance.
